# laravel_forge_organizations (Data Source)

Data source for listing Forge organizations the user has access to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all organizations
data "laravel_forge_organizations" "all" {}

# Filter by slug
data "laravel_forge_organizations" "personal" {
  filter {
    name   = "slug"
    values = ["personal"]
  }
}

# Filter by name (partial match)
data "laravel_forge_organizations" "team" {
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["Team"]
  }
}

# Output
output "all_organizations" {
  value = data.laravel_forge_organizations.all.organizations
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) Filter block for selecting specific organizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `organizations` (Attributes List) List of organizations the user has access to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by (e.g., 'name', 'slug')
- `values` (List of String) The list of values to match for the specified field


<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp
- `id` (Number) The organization ID

- `owner` (Boolean) Whether the user is the owner
- `slug` (String) The organization slug
